summary_en: 940,000 ordinary shares (7.64% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be cancelled effective 2026-07-24. Post-cancellation issued shares: 11,360,000. Treasury to fall to zero after processing of 360,000-share restricted stock award vest on same date. New buyback authorization to commence 2026-07-21.
title_en: Notice of Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-17, GENDAI AGENCY resolved by board decision under the Companies Act Article 178 to cancel 940,000 ordinary treasury shares, representing 7.64% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury). The cancellation is effective 2026-07-24. Post-cancellation, issued shares will total 11,360,000 and treasury will reach zero after a concurrent vesting of 360,000 restricted stock awards (announced 2026-06-26, payable same date). The company separately disclosed today a new share buyback authorization commencing 2026-07-21.
